title: Supreme Court refuses to stay Speaker Om Birla's decision to clear Uddhav Sena MPs' merger with Shinde Sena
description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday asked Lok Sabha Speaker to respond to a petition challenging his decision to recognize the merger of six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs with Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena.A Bench of Justices PS Narasimha and Alok Aradhe, however, declined to immediately stay the merger."We have issued notice.
